value.answer: It depends on your down payment. If you're putting less than 20% down (insured), the lowest 5-year fixed I can see is about 4.34% as of today, from lenders like Frank Mortgage. If you're putting 20% or more down (uninsured), the lowest is around 4.44%. The big banks are higher, averaging about 5.14%, and rates have been climbing this month.
